workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Post-upgrade validation for Zowe V3: services, STCs, version, keyring

variable.name: ZOWE_VERSION_EXPECTED
variable.label: Expected Zowe Version
variable.abstract: Version string to match in zowe.yaml (e.g. 3.0.0)
variable.description: The Zowe version string that should appear in zowe.yaml after the upgrade. Used by the checkVersion step to confirm the correct version was installed.

variable.name: ZOWE_YAML_PATH
variable.label: Zowe YAML Path
variable.abstract: Full USS path to the zowe.yaml configuration file
variable.description: The USS path to the zowe.yaml file for this Zowe instance. Used by checkVersion and writeReport.

variable.name: ZOWE_ZFS_MOUNT
variable.label: Zowe zFS Mount Point
variable.abstract: USS mount point for the Zowe runtime zFS (e.g. /usr/lpp/zowe)
variable.description: The USS path where the Zowe runtime zFS is mounted. Used by checkZfsMounted to confirm the filesystem is still mounted after the upgrade.

variable.name: APIML_HOST
variable.label: APIML Hostname
variable.abstract: Hostname of the Zowe API Mediation Layer gateway
variable.description: The hostname (or IP) of the z/OS system running the Zowe APIML gateway. Used to construct the base URL for REST probes.

variable.name: APIML_PORT
variable.label: APIML Gateway Port
variable.abstract: HTTPS port of the Zowe API Gateway (default 7554)
variable.description: The HTTPS port on which the Zowe API Gateway listens. Default Zowe V3 value is 7554.

variable.name: KEYRING_OWNER
variable.label: Keyring Owner
variable.abstract: RACF user ID that owns the Zowe keyring (usually IZUSVR)
variable.description: The RACF user ID that owns the Zowe keyring. Used by checkKeyring to run RACDCERT LISTRING.

variable.name: KEYRING_NAME
variable.label: Keyring Name
variable.abstract: Name of the Zowe RACF keyring (usually ZoweKeyring)
variable.description: The name of the RACF keyring used by Zowe. Used by checkKeyring.

variable.name: ZOWE_LOG_DIR
variable.label: Zowe Log Directory
variable.abstract: USS path to the Zowe instance log directory
variable.description: The directory where Zowe writes its runtime logs. Used by checkLogErrors to scan for SEVERE or ERROR messages after the upgrade.

variable.name: VALIDATION_SUMMARY
variable.label: Validation Summary
variable.abstract: Filled by the deriveStatus step. Overall PASS or FAIL verdict.
variable.description: Overall validation result set by the operator in the deriveStatus step after reviewing all automated check outputs. Value appears in the final readiness report.

variable.name: APPROVER
variable.label: Approver User ID
variable.abstract: User ID of the person signing off on the post-upgrade validation
variable.description: The TSO user ID of the person completing the validation sign-off. Recorded in the final report for change management purposes.

variable.name: REPORT_PATH
variable.label: Report Output Path
variable.abstract: USS path where the validation report will be written
variable.description: The full USS file path for the post-upgrade validation report. Defaults to /z/andre/zowe/post-upgrade-validation.log.

step.name: probeGateway
step.title: Probe API Gateway
step.description: Sends GET /gateway/api/v1/version to confirm the Zowe API Gateway is responding after the upgrade. HTTP 200 = PASS.
step.instructions:
Sends GET https://${instance-APIML_HOST}:${instance-APIML_PORT}/gateway/api/v1/version
PASS : HTTP 200 — gateway is up and responding FAIL : Any other HTTP status — gateway not reachable or crashed
If this step fails, check that ZWESLSTC started task is running and that the gateway port (${instance-APIML_PORT}) is listening.

step.name: probeDiscovery
step.title: Probe Discovery Service
step.description: Sends GET /eureka/apps to confirm the Zowe Discovery Service is responding after the upgrade. HTTP 200 = PASS.
step.instructions:
Sends GET /eureka/apps through the gateway.
PASS : HTTP 200 — discovery service is up FAIL : Any other status — discovery service not reachable
If this step fails, check ZWESLSTC logs for Discovery registration errors.

step.name: probeCatalog
step.title: Probe API Catalog
step.description: Sends GET /apicatalog/api/v1/containers to confirm the API Catalog is serving tiles after the upgrade. HTTP 200 = PASS.
step.instructions:
Sends GET /apicatalog/api/v1/containers.
PASS : HTTP 200 — catalog is up and returning tile data FAIL : Any other status — catalog not responding
An empty tile list (HTTP 200, empty body) is still a PASS for connectivity purposes; review the spool output to confirm expected services are registered.

step.name: probeZoweAuth
step.title: Probe Zowe Auth JWT Endpoint
step.description: Sends GET /gateway/api/v1/auth/keys/public/jwks.json to confirm the Zowe authentication service is publishing its JWT public key after the upgrade.
step.instructions:
Sends GET /gateway/api/v1/auth/keys/public/jwks.json
PASS : HTTP 200 — auth service is up and serving JWT keys FAIL : Any other status — auth service not responding
A missing or invalid JWT key will cause all Zowe token-based authentication to fail. This is a critical post-upgrade check.

step.name: checkVersion
step.title: Check zowe.yaml Version
step.description: Reads zowe.yaml and confirms the version field matches the expected Zowe V3 version string supplied in ZOWE_VERSION_EXPECTED.
step.instructions:
Greps the v.version or zowe.runtimeDirectory version field in ${instance-ZOWE_YAML_PATH} for the string "${instance-ZOWE_VERSION_EXPECTED}".
PASS : Version string found in zowe.yaml FAIL : File not found, or version string does not match
If the version does not match, the wrong Zowe build may have been installed. Compare the FMID applied in SMP/E against the expected version.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh YAML="${instance-ZOWE_YAML_PATH}" EXPECTED="${instance-ZOWE_VERSION_EXPECTED}" echo "=== zowe.yaml Version Check ===" echo "File : $YAML" echo "Expected : $EXPECTED" echo "--------------------------------" if [ ! -f "$YAML" ]; then echo "RESULT : FAIL (zowe.yaml not found at $YAML)" exit 0 fi echo "--- version-related lines in zowe.yaml ---" grep -i "version" "$YAML" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^#" | head -10 echo "------------------------------------------" if grep -q "$EXPECTED" "$YAML" 2>/dev/null; then echo "RESULT : PASS (version $EXPECTED found in zowe.yaml)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (version $EXPECTED not found in zowe.yaml - check SMP/E apply)" fi

step.name: checkZfsMounted
step.title: Check Zowe zFS Mount
step.description: Confirms the Zowe runtime zFS is still mounted at ZOWE_ZFS_MOUNT after the upgrade. A missing mount means Zowe cannot access its runtime files.
step.instructions:
Runs df -k on ${instance-ZOWE_ZFS_MOUNT} to confirm the zFS is mounted and reports free space.
PASS : Mount point exists and df returns data FAIL : Mount point directory does not exist or is not mounted
If this fails, check that the Zowe zFS was re-mounted during IPL or in the /etc/rc startup procedure.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh MOUNT="${instance-ZOWE_ZFS_MOUNT}" echo "=== Zowe zFS Mount Check ===" echo "Mount : $MOUNT" echo "----------------------------" if [ ! -d "$MOUNT" ]; then echo "RESULT : FAIL (directory $MOUNT does not exist)" exit 0 fi DF_OUT=$(df -k "$MOUNT" 2>/dev/null | tail -1) if [ -z "$DF_OUT" ]; then echo "RESULT : FAIL ($MOUNT exists but df returned no data - not mounted?)" exit 0 fi echo "df output : $DF_OUT" FREE_KB=$(echo "$DF_OUT" | awk '{print $3}') FREE_GB=$(echo "$FREE_KB 1048576" | awk '{printf "%.2f", $1/$2}') echo "Free space: ${FREE_GB} GB" echo "RESULT : PASS (zFS mounted at $MOUNT, ${FREE_GB} GB free)"

step.name: checkSTCsRunning
step.title: Check Zowe Started Tasks
step.description: Uses tsocmd to issue D A,STC to check whether ZWESLSTC, ZWESISTC, and ZWESAUX are active address spaces.
step.instructions:
Issues D A,ZWESLSTC / D A,ZWESISTC / D A,ZWESAUX via tsocmd.
PASS : All three STCs appear in the D A output WARN : One or two STCs are running (partial start) FAIL : No Zowe STCs found
ZWESISTC = Cross-memory server (required for APF-auth services) ZWESAUX = Auxiliary address space ZWESLSTC = Main Zowe server (launcher, APIML, ZSS, etc.)

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh echo "=== Zowe STC Status Check ===" echo "Checking: ZWESLSTC ZWESISTC ZWESAUX" echo "-----------------------------" FOUND=0 for STC in ZWESLSTC ZWESISTC ZWESAUX; do OUT=$(tsocmd "D A,$STC" 2>&1) echo "--- D A,$STC ---" echo "$OUT" echo "$OUT" | grep -q "$STC" if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "STATUS : $STC ACTIVE" FOUND=$((FOUND+1)) else echo "STATUS : $STC NOT FOUND in D A output" fi echo "" done echo "-----------------------------" if [ $FOUND -eq 3 ]; then echo "RESULT : PASS (all 3 Zowe STCs active)" elif [ $FOUND -gt 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : WARN ($FOUND/3 Zowe STCs active - check STC logs)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (no Zowe STCs found - STCs may not have started)" fi

step.name: checkKeyring
step.title: Check RACF Keyring Intact
step.description: Runs RACDCERT LISTRING to confirm the Zowe keyring is present and has connected certificates after the upgrade. Certificate rotation during upgrade can leave the keyring empty.
step.instructions:
Runs RACDCERT ID(${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}) LISTRING(${instance-KEYRING_NAME}) via tsocmd.
PASS : Keyring exists (RC=0) and output lists connected certs FAIL : RACDCERT returns non-zero (keyring missing or empty)
Review the full RACDCERT output to confirm: - Zowe server certificate is connected - CA certificate is connected - Certificate labels match what zowe.yaml references

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh echo "=== RACF Keyring Integrity Check ===" echo "Owner : ${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}" echo "Ring : ${instance-KEYRING_NAME}" echo "------------------------------------" tsocmd "RACDCERT ID(${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}) LISTRING(${instance-KEYRING_NAME})" 2>&1 RC=$? if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : PASS (keyring found, RC=0)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (RACDCERT returned RC=$RC - keyring may be missing or empty)" fi

step.name: checkLogErrors
step.title: Check Zowe Logs for Errors
step.description: Scans the most recent Zowe log file in ZOWE_LOG_DIR for SEVERE or ERROR level messages. Any errors found are printed to the spool for review.
step.instructions:
Finds the most recent file in ${instance-ZOWE_LOG_DIR} and greps for SEVERE or ERROR (case-insensitive).
PASS : No SEVERE or ERROR lines found in the log WARN : ERROR lines found (non-fatal issues) FAIL : SEVERE lines found (critical startup failures)
Review any errors before declaring the upgrade successful. Common post-upgrade errors: certificate mismatch, missing environment variables, wrong Java version.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh LOG_DIR="${instance-ZOWE_LOG_DIR}" echo "=== Zowe Log Error Scan ===" echo "Log dir : $LOG_DIR" echo "---------------------------" if [ ! -d "$LOG_DIR" ]; then echo "RESULT : FAIL (log directory $LOG_DIR not found)" exit 0 fi LATEST=$(ls -t "$LOG_DIR"/*.log 2>/dev/null | head -1) if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then echo "WARN: no .log files found in $LOG_DIR" LATEST=$(ls -t "$LOG_DIR"/* 2>/dev/null | head -1) fi if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then echo "RESULT : FAIL (no log files found in $LOG_DIR)" exit 0 fi echo "Scanning : $LATEST" echo "--- SEVERE lines (last 50) ---" SEVERE=$(grep -i "SEVERE" "$LATEST" 2>/dev/null | tail -50) echo "$SEVERE" SEVERE_COUNT=$(echo "$SEVERE" | grep -c "SEVERE" 2>/dev/null) echo "--- ERROR lines (last 20) ---" ERR=$(grep -i " ERROR " "$LATEST" 2>/dev/null | tail -20) echo "$ERR" ERR_COUNT=$(echo "$ERR" | grep -c "ERROR" 2>/dev/null) echo "-----------------------------" echo "SEVERE count : $SEVERE_COUNT" echo "ERROR count : $ERR_COUNT" if [ "$SEVERE_COUNT" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "RESULT : FAIL ($SEVERE_COUNT SEVERE message(s) found - review log before sign-off)" elif [ "$ERR_COUNT" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "RESULT : WARN ($ERR_COUNT ERROR message(s) found - review but may be non-fatal)" else echo "RESULT : PASS (no SEVERE or ERROR messages found in latest log)" fi

step.name: checkPortsLive
step.title: Check Zowe Ports Listening
step.description: Uses netstat to confirm the core Zowe V3 ports (7554 gateway, 7556 discovery, 7552 catalog, 7553 ZAAS, 8544 ZSS) are in LISTEN state.
step.instructions:
Runs netstat -an and checks for LISTEN on each Zowe port.
PASS : All 5 ports are in LISTEN state WARN : Some ports listening (partial start) FAIL : No Zowe ports found listening
Port reference: 7554 API Gateway 7556 Discovery Service 7552 API Catalog 7553 ZAAS (Zowe Auth and Access Service) 8544 ZSS (z/OS Services Server)

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh echo "=== Zowe Port Listening Check ===" echo "Ports: 7554 7556 7552 7553 8544" echo "---------------------------------" LISTEN=0 TOTAL=5 for PORT in 7554 7556 7552 7553 8544; do OUT=$(netstat -an 2>/dev/null | grep "\\.$PORT " | grep -i "listen") if [ -n "$OUT" ]; then echo "PORT $PORT : LISTENING" echo " $OUT" LISTEN=$((LISTEN+1)) else echo "PORT $PORT : NOT LISTENING" fi done echo "---------------------------------" if [ $LISTEN -eq $TOTAL ]; then echo "RESULT : PASS (all $TOTAL Zowe ports are listening)" elif [ $LISTEN -gt 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : WARN ($LISTEN/$TOTAL ports listening - Zowe may be partially started)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (no Zowe ports found listening - check STC startup)" fi

step.name: deriveStatus
step.title: Record Validation Verdict
step.description: Operator reviews all automated step outputs and records the overall validation verdict in VALIDATION_SUMMARY before the sign-off gate.
step.instructions:
Review the spool output from all preceding steps and set VALIDATION_SUMMARY to one of:
PASS — all checks passed, upgrade successful WARN — minor issues found, upgrade functionally complete FAIL — critical issues found, upgrade needs remediation
Also enter your TSO user ID in APPROVER.
Do not sign off with FAIL unless all issues are documented in the change record.

step.name: approvalGate
step.title: Post-Upgrade Validation Sign-Off
step.description: Manual step. Operator reviews all automated check results and signs off that the Zowe V3 upgrade is validated. The final report is not written until this step is marked complete.
step.instructions:
Review the outputs from all preceding steps before marking this step complete.
Checklist: [ ] API Gateway responded HTTP 200 [ ] Discovery Service responded HTTP 200 [ ] API Catalog responded HTTP 200 [ ] JWT auth endpoint responded HTTP 200 [ ] zowe.yaml version matches ${instance-ZOWE_VERSION_EXPECTED} [ ] Zowe zFS mounted at ${instance-ZOWE_ZFS_MOUNT} [ ] All 3 Zowe STCs (ZWESLSTC, ZWESISTC, ZWESAUX) active [ ] RACF keyring ${instance-KEYRING_NAME} intact [ ] No SEVERE messages in Zowe logs [ ] All 5 Zowe ports in LISTEN state
Validation verdict : ${instance-VALIDATION_SUMMARY} Approver : ${instance-APPROVER}
Mark this step complete to generate the final report.

step.name: writeReport
step.title: Write Post-Upgrade Validation Report
step.description: Writes a timestamped post-upgrade validation report to REPORT_PATH on USS and surfaces the report on the JES spool for archiving.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh REPORT="${instance-REPORT_PATH}" TS=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') APPROVER="${instance-APPROVER}" echo "Writing report to $REPORT" echo "============================================================" > "$REPORT" echo " Zowe V3 Post-Upgrade Validation Report" >> "$REPORT" echo " Generated : $TS" >> "$REPORT" echo " Approver : $APPROVER" >> "$REPORT" echo "============================================================" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "CONFIGURATION VALIDATED" >> "$REPORT" echo " APIML host : ${instance-APIML_HOST}:${instance-APIML_PORT}" >> "$REPORT" echo " Zowe version : ${instance-ZOWE_VERSION_EXPECTED}" >> "$REPORT" echo " zowe.yaml : ${instance-ZOWE_YAML_PATH}" >> "$REPORT" echo " zFS mount : ${instance-ZOWE_ZFS_MOUNT}" >> "$REPORT" echo " Keyring owner : ${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}" >> "$REPORT" echo " Keyring name : ${instance-KEYRING_NAME}" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "AUTOMATED CHECKS" >> "$REPORT" echo " 1. API Gateway (HTTP 200) - see probeGateway step" >> "$REPORT" echo " 2. Discovery Service (HTTP 200) - see probeDiscovery" >> "$REPORT" echo " 3. API Catalog (HTTP 200) - see probeCatalog" >> "$REPORT" echo " 4. JWT Auth endpoint (HTTP 200) - see probeZoweAuth" >> "$REPORT" echo " 5. zowe.yaml version check - see checkVersion" >> "$REPORT" echo " 6. zFS mount check - see checkZfsMounted" >> "$REPORT" echo " 7. Zowe STCs running - see checkSTCsRunning" >> "$REPORT" echo " 8. RACF keyring intact - see checkKeyring" >> "$REPORT" echo " 9. Log error scan - see checkLogErrors" >> "$REPORT" echo " 10. Port availability check - see checkPortsLive" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "VALIDATION VERDICT" >> "$REPORT" echo " ${instance-VALIDATION_SUMMARY}" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "SIGN-OFF" >> "$REPORT" echo " Approved by : $APPROVER" >> "$REPORT" echo " Approved at : $TS" >> "$REPORT" echo " Workflow : zowe-post-upgrade-validation v1.0" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "============================================================" >> "$REPORT" echo " Retain this report for change management records." >> "$REPORT" echo "============================================================" >> "$REPORT" echo "" echo "=== Report written to $REPORT ===" cat "$REPORT"
